evidence.title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded

summary: Xiaomi announced its latest processor, claiming single‑core speed on par with Apple’s latest silicon while delivering substantially higher multi‑core throughput. The chip is set to power upcoming Xiaomi devices, marking a major step in the company’s in‑house chipset development.
title: Xiaomi unveils new CPU that rivals Apple’s single‑thread performance and outpaces it in multi‑thread workloads
